Legal_Mechanism: Swiss Federal Council Emergency Ordinance (Articles 184 and 185 of Swiss Federal Constitution), suspending shareholder voting rights
Exchange_Ratio: 1 UBS share for every 22.48 Credit Suisse shares

AT1_Bail_In_Write_Down.Legal_Controversy: Complete write-down of Tier 1 subordinated debt to zero while common equity holders received CHF 3B, upending standard creditor priority hierarchy (absolute priority rule) and sparking multi-billion dollar lawsuits in Swiss, US, and UK courts.

Swiss_State_and_Central_Bank_Liquidity_S.Federal_Loss_Protection_Guarantee_for_UB: 9 billion (for losses on non-core portfolio exceeding CHF 5 billion, later terminated voluntarily by UBS in August 2023)
